# Sanitised structural corpus derived from a real published catalogue.
#
# One line per distinct parameter shape, which is what fidelity depends on. Every parameter
# combination is verbatim; every value that could identify a third party is not.
#
# What is synthetic, and it is now all of it: credentials are one placeholder UUID, addresses are
# RFC 5737 documentation space (198.51.100.0/24) or example.com, and the sni / host / peer
# parameters are s<NN>.example.com. The header used to claim hostnames were synthetic while
# roughly thirty sni values were the real hostnames of other people's nodes, plus two routable
# addresses — a claim that was false in a public repository, and the exact thing GHOST-048 says
# this project does not do: republish somebody else's endpoints in a second, more permanent form.
#
# What is kept verbatim, deliberately: the Reality masking targets that are major public sites
# (apple, amazon, google, microsoft, cloudflare, paypal, ebay, yandex, yahoo, bing, vk, rutube).
# Those are camouflage domains, not anybody's infrastructure, and which sites the ecosystem
# actually masks as is the one piece of real-world signal this file exists to preserve.
#
# Shapes are preserved where a decoder branches on them: label count, mixed case, percent-encoded
# junk, hyphen-joined repeats, and a bogus TLD. The names carry no identity, only the form.
